description: DB migration up/down and real settings round-trip with two tenants: cross-tenant/default deletion FK violations fail; unrelated settings survive.

DB resolver matrix: configured 10% beats older rate; inactive/missing/foreign/expired/future or inactive-region configuration fails; date boundaries, absent setting and no-active-rate fallback match policy.
Settings action/UI flow saves and reloads a region-labelled default; permission denial and concurrent source-setting save preserve data; empty and invalid configuration states are actionable.

DB-backed lifecycle guards reject deletion/deactivation/re-regioning or date invalidation of a configured default; replacement/clear allows applicable mutation; race with assignment cannot create invalid links.

DB initializer creates one default association and profile-keyed settings, visible through the real region reader; repeated and concurrent calls and a second profile preserve overrides and component counts, including fractional rates.
DB initializer repair covers existing nondefault association and conflicting location association without destroying location data or violating uniqueness.
Parameterized client entrypoint tests cover UI action, API, shared model and Entra success and forced tax failure rollback; AlgaDesk and explicit skip behavior remain valid.
DB-backed UI-action/service-API/product-API create matrix covers omitted, explicit NULL, explicit valid UUID, invalid/foreign ID and no configured default; schema parsing retains omission.
Quick-add interaction tests verify inherited display/payload, explicit rate/non-taxable, reset, late fetch preserving choice, and product edit retaining saved NULL/UUID.
DB backfill preview/apply with services/products, other tenant, existing assignments and excluded rows updates only selected NULLs; retry is idempotent and reports counts.

DB backfill guard tests cover denied permissions, foreign IDs, changed default, rate invalidation, concurrent explicit assignment and newly created NULL rows outside preview; invalid requests do not partially mutate.

Billing regression: single uncapped 10% GST rate yields 10.00 on 100.00 net for inherited client/catalog; non-taxable, exempt and external-source paths retain behavior; changing default does not rewrite existing assignments/invoices.
